2. New English Music Mode: JPOP – Includes 13 brand-new Japanese songs.
3. Five New Vehicles – In the main game mode of Drive and Unwind, you can now drive a taxi, fire truck, police car, sports car, and truck.

notes.title: V1.2.0 Update Notice – New Vehicle: Scooter, New Game Mode: Car Escape
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="taODubxLh8w;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Hello everyone, the game Drive and Unwind has now been updated to new version V1.2.0[/p][p][/p][p]In this version, we’ve added a new vehicle: the scooter.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610176/ff7944c8c4b26a1344a1f90e73212c990500f0e8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Game Mode feature offers a variety of gameplay options to choose from.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610176/c2a36734a79d417f475e72629f93d544d205d838.png"][/img][/p][p]Currently, we offer a new game mode called **Car Escape**.[/p][p]You can tap the gear icon in the top right corner to enter the level selection or restart the current level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610176/b42e9409d054490f1a9f0525f7fd1cf19466a4cf.png"][/img][/p][p]As the name suggests, Car Escape requires you to clear all the cars from the screen to complete the level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610176/907c1b642f3c89a112ba0f47671307ab95271f32.png"][/img]
[/p][p]We hope you enjoy this update, and we’ll see you next time![/p]

tags.feature: In this version, we’ve added a new vehicle: the scooter.
Currently, we offer a new game mode called **Car Escape**.
